name: Etizolam Powder
description:
Buy Etizolam powder online

Buy Etizolam powder online (marketed under the brand name Etilaam, Etizola, Sedekopan, Etizest, Pasaden or Depas) is a benzodiazepine analog. Also, This molecule differs from a benzodiazepine in that the benzene ring has been replaced by a thiophene ring and the triazole ring has been fused, making the drug a thienotriazolodiazepine. It possesses amnesic, anxiolytic, anticonvulsant, hypnotic, sedative, and skeletal muscle relaxant properties.

ETIZOLAM BENEFITS AND EFFECTS

Etizolam was originally developed as a treatment for anxiety and sleep disorders but has been found to be effective in other treatments too.

Etizolam was found to show a marked improvement in chronic anxiety and phobic ideas.  In another study, patients  – treated over 5 weeks – showed significant improvement in anxiety and depressive symptoms.

Etizolam was compared with Alprazolam and Bromazepam in the treatment of generalized anxiety disorder. Etizolam outperformed both of the other drugs in the trial for its antidepressant effect.

One study using Etizolam showed the complete disappearance of auditory hallucinations in a schizophrenic patient.

A study using rats showed that a regular dosage of Etizolam significantly reduced the sleep latency of the subjects. Insomnia returned as the Etizolam dosage stopped.

Etizolam was used to test pain reduction from tension-type headaches, using a combination of Etizolam and NSAID. Young and female patients showed a statistically significant reduction in pain using the combination of Etizolam and NSAID.
